tickets.subject: Heatless curling set - curls not holding

tickets.summary: Customer with fine straight hair struggling to hold curls with heatless set. Sent tailored tutorial. Issue resolved with education, no product defect.

tickets.subject: Order charged twice
tickets.resolution: Confirmed duplicate charge due to checkout timeout and re-submit. One order cancelled and full refund issued within 2 hours. Only one order fulfilled.
tickets.summary: Customer hit back button during checkout and resubmitted, causing two charges. One order voided and refunded same day.

tickets.subject: Satin pillowcase fabric pilling after 3 washes
tickets.resolution: Confirmed pilling is likely due to washing in hot water or with rough fabrics. Shared proper care instructions. Offered replacement as goodwill since customer was within 30 days of purchase.
tickets.summary: Pillowcase pilling after washing. Likely care instruction issue. Replacement offered within 30-day window with care guide sent.

tickets.subject: Scrunchies losing elasticity after a few weeks
tickets.summary: Customer says satin scrunchies lost elasticity after ~3 weeks of daily use. Currently unassigned.

tickets.subject: Shampoo bar not lathering well

tickets.summary: Customer expected more lather from shampoo bar. Educated on how bar shampoos work vs liquid. No product defect.

resolution_playbooks.title: Defective Product — Standard Resolution
steps: Acknowledge the issue and apologize sincerely
Ask for a photo of the defect if not already provided
Confirm defect is valid (not wear-and-tear or misuse)
Issue replacement via priority shipping, waive return requirement
Add $5 store credit as goodwill if this is the customer's first defect report
If second defect on same SKU: escalate to senior agent and flag to product team
do_not: Suggest the customer caused the defect
Ask them to return before sending replacement
resolution_playbooks.template_response: Hi [Name], I'm so sorry your [product] arrived with a defect — that's absolutely not the experience we want for you! I've gone ahead and processed a replacement that will ship out [today/next business day]. You don't need to return the original. I've also added a small store credit to your account as an apology. Please let me know if there's anything else I can help with! 💕

resolution_playbooks.title: Lost / Missing Package
steps: Confirm order details and last tracking event
If tracking has not moved in 5+ business days: open carrier investigation
Inform customer that investigation takes up to 15 business days
If investigation confirms lost OR 15 business days pass: issue full refund or replacement (customer's choice)
Add $10 store credit for the wait
If customer is urgent or high-value (LTV >$200): offer resolution before investigation completes
do_not: Make the customer wait 15 days without any update
resolution_playbooks.template_response: Hi [Name], I'm so sorry your package hasn't arrived! I've opened an investigation with the carrier and will follow up with you within [X] business days. If it can't be located, I'll make it right with a full replacement or refund — whichever you prefer. I'm adding a $10 credit to your account for the inconvenience. Thank you for your patience! 💛

resolution_playbooks.title: Usage Guidance — Heatless Curling Set
steps: Ask about hair type (fine, thick, straight, wavy) and how long they left the set in
Send tutorial video link: https://kitsch.com/blogs/tutorials/heatless-curls
For fine/straight hair: recommend leaving in 6-8 hours or overnight
For thick hair: recommend sectioning more and slightly damp hair
Offer 15% off next purchase if customer is frustrated
If customer insists product is defective after guidance: issue replacement
do_not: Immediately offer a replacement before educating
resolution_playbooks.template_response: Hi [Name], thank you for reaching out! The heatless curling set does take a little practice to get perfect results for your hair type. I'd love to help you get those gorgeous curls! Here are some tips specifically for [hair type]: [tips]. Check out our tutorial here: [link]. Let me know how it goes — and if you're still not getting the results you love, I'll make it right! 🌀

resolution_playbooks.title: Usage Guidance — Shampoo Bar (Hard Water / Residue)
steps: Ask if the customer is in a hard water area
Explain the transition period (2-4 weeks for scalp adjustment)
Recommend apple cider vinegar rinse (1 tbsp in 1 cup water) to combat hard water buildup
Suggest lathering bar in hands first before applying to hair
Offer 50% off next purchase if customer is unsatisfied
Accept return/refund if customer has tried tips and still unhappy
do_not: Tell the customer they are using it wrong in a blunt way
Dismiss hard water as not a real factor
resolution_playbooks.template_response: Hi [Name], thanks for sharing this with us! What you're experiencing is actually common when switching to a bar shampoo, especially in hard water areas — it's a normal transition period that usually lasts 2-4 weeks. Here's a tip that works wonders: try an apple cider vinegar rinse (1 tbsp in 1 cup water) after washing to remove any mineral buildup. [Continue with tips...] We want you to love it! 🌿

resolution_playbooks.title: Health / Safety / Allergic Reaction — ESCALATE IMMEDIATELY
steps: Do NOT attempt to resolve independently — escalate to Camille Torres (Escalations Specialist) immediately
Do not admit liability or suggest the product caused the reaction
Acknowledge the customer's experience with empathy
Offer full refund immediately — no return required
Do NOT offer compensation beyond refund without legal approval
Document all details: symptoms, product batch if available, photos if customer provides
Legal team must be notified within 1 hour of ticket creation
do_not: Offer monetary compensation beyond refund without legal sign-off
resolution_playbooks.template_response: Hi [Name], I'm so sorry to hear about your experience — your health and safety are our absolute top priority. I've immediately escalated your case to our senior team who will reach out to you directly within [X] hours. In the meantime, I've processed a full refund to your original payment method — no return needed. Please don't hesitate to contact us if your symptoms worsen, and we'd encourage you to consult a healthcare professional if you haven't already.
